name: 영치코
wear: A feather-crest headpiece, yellow upper breastplate divided sharply from burnt-orange waist and thigh plates; short tail-shaped sash hanging behind the belt, steel-gray shin guards and small claw-shaped trim on boots and forearm guards without replacing human fingers.

casual.scene: Inside an empty sunlit dance rehearsal studio in the early morning, marking a gentle rhythmic step with both open hands at waist height, palms angled toward camera and separated. Face directed forward, no mirrors, pale wood floor and diffuse windows.
casual.outfit: Opaque golden-yellow sleeveless cropped racerback dance top and burnt-orange high-waisted wide-leg practice trousers, small gray bracelet; bare shoulders arms and midriff.

casual.scene: At an empty railway station concourse on an overcast afternoon, paused beside a compact orange suitcase, one hand loosely holding its upright handle and the other raised open in a small wave. Full head and shoes in frame, no signage or writing, soft skylight.
casual.outfit: Opaque white cropped buttoned sleeveless shirt, orange high-waisted tailored Bermuda shorts, gray trainers and a small feather brooch; bare arms midriff and lower legs.

casual.scene: At an original retro roller-disco themed stage event before opening, leaning side-on on a low padded bench with face turned to camera, one hand adjusting a decorative wrist ribbon, the other resting separately on the bench. Purple and gold evening stage lights, no other people.
casual.outfit: Original adult roller-performer event costume: opaque yellow halter bodice, burnt-orange high-waisted skater mini skirt, gray ankle boots and small feather earrings. Bare shoulders arms and legs; decorative stage fashion without armor or insignia.
